recognize_zh: 這是一張純文字投影片（非形態學影像），說明期中 PET 以 ΔSUVmax 評估的方法：取基期與期中 PET 最活躍病灶的 SUVmax 計算下降百分比，ROC 決定的切點為 PET0-2 下降 66%、PET0-4 下降 72.9%。
features: Text slide describing delta SUVmax assessment for interim PET in DLBCL
Baseline PET0: SUVmax in the most active lesion
Interim PET: SUVmax in the most active lesion if positive, or in the PET0 tumor area if negative
Percent SUVmax reduction calculated per Lin et al, J Nucl Med 2007
ROC-derived optimal cut-offs: 66% for PET0-2 and 72.9% for PET0-4
describe_en: This non-morphologic text slide describes the semiquantitative delta SUVmax method for interim PET assessment in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. The SUVmax of the most active lesion is measured at baseline and at interim PET (or in the region of the baseline tumor if the interim scan is negative), and the percentage reduction is calculated. ROC-derived cut-offs of 66% after two cycles and 72.9% after four cycles separate good from poor responders, offering a more reproducible alternative to purely visual interpretation in patients receiving R-CHOP.
